title: Prepare private Vault release-path operational rollout
expected_outcome: A reviewed, non-secret GitOps and operations-ready contract can be used to provision private runner-to-Vault connectivity and transition the release workflow only after a separately authorized deployment.
constraints: Do not deploy, publish, merge, alter secrets, access AWS, or access production.
Do not change release.yml until a private runner and Vault route are operationally authorized.
Keep all evidence non-sensitive and fail closed for missing prerequisites.

primary_owner.responsibility: security decisions, integration, and final sign-off

delegations.escalation_trigger: the required contract needs cloud state or a secret
implementation would alter deployment state, a workflow, or credentials
task bundle or validation evidence is incomplete
